study: R5-V CCCC QA research prototype B-C (self-checks; no thresholds, no Q3 calibration)

columns.lambda_low_hex / _down: certified lower bound of lambda_min(K) of the system solved (certify_lambda_min)
columns.rel_to_exact_bc_hex / _up: certified upper bound of ||s_BC - s*||_2/||s*||_2 = b/(L - b), L > b
columns.rel_to_exact_ac_hex / _up: the same for R-AC with refinement
columns.bc_ac_certified_consistent, bc_rh_certif: exact check ||s_BC - s_ref|| <= b_BC + b_ref (must be True)
columns.capacitance_path, cond_S_modal, cond_S_r: S by the modal path (m, default) and by the rows of Y0 (g); cond(S) is that of the chosen path; ||S_g - S_m||_2/||S_m||_2 (PB-2; OBSERVATION)
columns.rho_0, kappa_bar_c, ratio_Y0c_x, M_norm_: factors of the corrected VOK-13 (fe5d60f): ||x0||/||x||, ||Y0||_2 ||c||_2/||x||, former kappa_c = ||Y0 c||/||x||; ||M||_2 by VOK-12 item 4 (f62cd79), dense for N m <= 4N, subspace otherwise (PB-3; OBSERVATION, not a guarantee); UNRESOLVED when ||x|| = 0
columns.run_class, qr_without_qualified_rank_dec: PB-4: every QR run is RESEARCH_ONLY (no qualified numerical rank decision); the result refers to span(U~); sine of the largest angle between span(U~) and span(G) (exact projection, OBSERVATION); such rows must not enter normative Q3 distributions
columns.note: per-row remark (e.g. eps = 1e-8 with QR: changed span)
columns.orthonormality_defect_up: exact max|h_f U~^T U~ - I| rounded up (QR control), value only
